name: novel-to-game
description: A source-grounded 7-skill novel-to-game workflow covering gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and art design, building a candidate for the target runtime, and evidence-based QA. It supports systems games, interactive fiction and interactive film. 忠于原著的 7-skill 小说改游戏工作流，涵盖游戏化拆书、概念选型、世界与美术设计、按目标运行环境构建游戏及实机运行验收，支持系统玩法、互动叙事与互动影游。

interface.shortDescription: Turn novels into playable game prototypes · 把小说改编成可玩的游戏
